sources.snippet: Summary Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 fails the GSM8K accuracy CI check on Blackwell (B200) GPUs. Investigation in #37618 identified the root cause as DeepGemm's E8M0 scale format on the dense FP8 block-quantized linear layers.
